What Is Cisco and Are Cisco Programmers in Demand

Cisco established itself as a global leader in IT, networking, and cybersecurity solutions that help businesses of any scale boost their communication and collaborative services. Cisco provides networking hardware, telecommunications equipment, and other high-technology products and services. 

The company’s main focus and solutions are concentrated on specific tech markets, such as IoT, domain security, and energy management. Therefore, nowadays, Cisco programmers are in high demand, and more and more companies want to hire Cisco network engineer to get all the benefits of the available technologies.

FAQ on Who Is Cisco Engineer and How to Hire Cisco Programmer

What is a Cisco engineer and why Cisco engineer certification is a must?

A Cisco engineer works with hardware and software used to run a business’ data network using the Cisco portfolio of products and services. Cisco programmer certification is a must because it highlights the level of expertise of the worker, and a higher grade means stronger performance and increased operational efficiency. Certified employees can work on complex tasks and deliver high-quality network operating services. Also, they are able to select the best technology solutions to meet the company’s needs.

What are the Cisco engineer grade levels?

These are Entry, Associate, Professional, Expert, and Architect. The Expert one is globally recognized as the most prestigious certification in the technology industry. The Architect certification is the highest level that proves the architectural expertise of the network designer.

Does a Cisco engineer need to learn Microsoft server to be in demand?

For a Cisco engineer for hire, it is not obligatory to have Microsoft certification. Cisco certifications are oriented more toward hardware and network engineering, while the Microsoft ones concentrate on server-side maintenance and software. However, for businesses, hiring a Cisco expert with Microsoft server certification can be beneficial, as such a specialist will have a wider range of expertise.

How to find Cisco engineer remotely?

You can find a freelance Cisco specialist, hire a Cisco engineer remote, or get a dedicated Cisco developers team working on your project by cooperating with an outstaffing services provider. The latter is the most reliable and cost-effective way to get a seasoned Cisco technology developer working remotely.

What is an hourly rate for Cisco engineer in Ukraine?

A Ukrainian Cisco software engineer costs only $6.93 per hour, translating into $13,300 annually. It is much lower than programmers of the same expertise earn in other countries, such as the US or Canada. That’s why many companies tend to outsource their Cisco software development to Ukraine and hire Ukrainian Cisco engineers.

Cisco Expert Roles and Responsibilities: What Are the Benefits for Businesses?

A Cisco network engineer runs and manages the company’s data networks using the Cisco suite of products and services. Duties and responsibilities of a Cisco network engineer include creating new data networks, troubleshooting the existing network solutions, and providing technical support for users. Cisco network engineers usually work with other developers closely and coordinate with various departments to monitor and meet the company’s needs regarding data networks. Cisco experts analyze how the system works to make sure that it operates according to the company’s requirements.

Cisco Certified Engineer: Why Does Certification Matter?

For a Cisco engineer, certification highlights the expertise of the programmer in the best way. It is known that certified Cisco experts are stronger performers and provide services of a higher quality to their employers or contractors. Moreover, the corresponding certification allows Cisco experts to choose the right technology solutions, thus, increasing the operational efficiency of various departments.

CCNA is the main certification that allows you to qualify as a skilled Cisco developer. Here are all the certifications structured and explained to note:

Entry

Description: allows a programmer to start their career as a Cisco network engineer.

Certificates available in the grade: CCT (Cisco Certified Technicians)

Details: the CCT certification confirms that the person has the necessary skills to diagnose, repair, and replace crucial Cisco network and system tools at customer sites.

Associate

Description: Proves that the programmer mastered the essentials needed to pursue a career as a Cisco network engineer and equipped with the knowledge of the latest Cisco technologies

Certificates: DevNet Associate, CCNA, CyberOps Associate.

Details: The DevNet Associate certification proves skills in developing and troubleshooting apps built on Cisco platforms. The CCNA certification confirms one’s knowledge of the fundamentals of the Cisco products and services, the latest networking technologies, and software development skills. The CyberOps shows that the programmer can work as an associate-level cybersecurity analyst within security operations centers.

Professional

Description: Highlights that the person is well-versed with the main tech track and can be considered a Middle/ Senior Cisco developer.

Certificates: DevNet Professional, CCNP Enterprise, Collaboration, Data Center, Security, Service Provider.

Details: The DevNet Professional certification is given to network engineers with proven skills in building and maintaining apps built on Cisco platforms. The CCNP Enterprise certification showcases expertise with enterprise networking, collaboration, security, data centers, and service provider solutions.

Expert

Description: This grade is accepted all over the world as the most prestigious one in the tech industries.

Certifications: CCDE (Cisco Certified Design Expert), CCIE Infrastructure, Wireless, Collaboration, Data Center, Security, Service, Provider.

Details: Network pros with expert-level knowledge and skills in network design can get the CCDE certification. The CCIE certification highlights the exceptional skills with complex enterprise infrastructure, enterprise wireless, collaboration, data center, security, and service provider solutions.

Architect

Description: It is the highest level of certification granted for the architectural expertise of the network designer.

Certificate: CCAr.

Details: received by senior network infrastructure architects who create tech network specifications to meet the complex requirements of the company.

Cisco Programmer Salary Rates in Different Countries

Although a Cisco programmer can obtain the desired certification from anywhere, the rates of Cisco specialists vary, especially depending on the country of birth and living. Here are the annual Cisco engineer salary rates in different countries to compare, according to Payscale:

  • The US – $69,339
  • Canada – C$71,783 ($50,918)
  • Germany – €50,001 ($54,098)
  • Bulgaria – BGN 24,000 (13,369)
  • Ukraine – $13,300

As you can see, network developer salary rates in Ukraine are much more affordable compared to other countries. That’s why many industries that want to hire Cisco contractors, turn their attention to Ukraine.
